item: Never-measured qualified sources are judged offline from their stored articles (R728 C)
refs: PR #2070; R728 C; field test 2026-11-14 report 5.3
summary: The field test found 6,411 curated sources and 0 measured on every instance: a curated stamp starts the 3-month re-check clock, so no curated source had ever been judged on its own pages. Now the re-check slots the due queues leave unused in a pass go to enabled qualified sources with no judging attempt and at least 10 stored articles (least-recently-attempted first), judged by the normal extraction verdict from what is already stored. No trial fetch is made for them, nothing is re-extracted, the per-pass budgets are unchanged, and recheck_per_pass = 0 still turns it off. A judged source leaves the pool because its verdict is a judging attempt; a source the operator switched off is never taken (a qualified verdict sets enabled, Q1101). The pass reports unmeasured_judged.
